note: The candidate SHT_GROUP payload supplies the section-reference word, and this statement decodes that input-controlled 32-bit value into gseca.

The bounds check rejects only indexes greater than the section count, so the one-past value gseca equal to ep->f_loc_shdr.g_count is not rejected although valid section indexes must be less than the count.

With gseca equal to the number of section headers, the computed targpsh pointer is one element past the allocated ep->f_shdr array and the following access uses that out-of-bounds section header pointer.
